name: facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdiplomacy/viz/meta_annotations/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.create_meta_annotator: create a MetaAnnotator instance to write annotations for a pydipcc game as it's being generated
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.add_annotation_to_game: add an annotation with encoded data, tag, phase, and timestamp to the MetaAnnotator records
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.commit_annotations_to_file: commit accumulated annotation records to the output file and clear the internal buffer
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.read_raw_records_from_file: read RawRecord annotations from a file and clean up inconsistent annotations produced due to requeue
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.handle_new_phase_transition: call after_new_phase on the MetaAnnotator when the game has stepped to a new phase

facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.start_global_annotation: start a global MetaAnnotator for a pydipcc game writing annotations to a given output path
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.stop_global_annotation_and_commit: stop the global annotator and commit all annotations for a pydipcc game
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.read_annotations: read and parse annotation records from a file path into a ParsedData object with categorized entries
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.add_pseudo_orders_next_msg: add pseudo orders data to the global annotator for the next message timestamp
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.maybe_kickoff_annotations: use a context manager to optionally start and stop global annotations for a game

facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.test_api_empty_annotations: test the ApiTest class to verify empty annotations return empty pseudoorders, nonsenses, and misc lists
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.test_api_follow_the_game: test the ApiTest class to verify annotations track messages added between France and Austria during game play
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.test_api_pseudo_order: test the ApiTest class to verify pseudo orders are logged with correct phase and timestamp when added before a message
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.test_api_misc_next_message: test the ApiTest class to verify add_dict_next_msg logs a policy dict with the correct phase and timestamp
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.test_api_misc_reject: test the ApiTest class to verify after_message_generation_failed rejects all or partial pending misc annotations

facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.dump_pseudoorders: dump a PseudoOrders object to a JSON-serializable state using PseudoOrdersDataType.dump
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.load_pseudoorders: load a PseudoOrders object from serialized state using PseudoOrdersDataType.load with version
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.dump_nonsense_annotation: dump a NonsenseAnnotation tuple to a JSON-serializable state using NonsenseDataType.dump
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.load_nonsense_annotation: load a NonsenseAnnotation tuple from serialized state using NonsenseDataType.load with version
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.list_known_tags: list all registered serialization tags using the KNOWN_TAGS frozenset constant

facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.test_PseudoOrdersDataType_cycle: test that PseudoOrdersDataType dump and load round-trips PseudoOrders data correctly for version 1
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.test_NonsenseDataType_cycle: test that NonsenseDataType dump and load round-trips a NonsenseAnnotation tuple correctly for version 1
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.run_PseudoOrdersDataType_test: run the parameterized unit test that encodes and decodes PseudoOrders for Italy and Austria in phase S1901M
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.run_NonsenseDataType_test: run the parameterized unit test that encodes and decodes a rejected pseudo order classifier annotation tuple
facebookresearch_diplomacycicero/fairdip.review_datatypes_test: review the unittest module that validates serialization round-trips for PseudoOrdersDataType and NonsenseDataType classes
